newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila hikes 3-mnth special bill rate to 13.10 pct.
newsitem.headline: Manila hikes 3-mnth special bill rate to 13.10 pct.

text.p: The Philippine central bank said on Monday it had raised its three-month special series Treasury bill rate to 13.10 percent from 12.10 percent.
The 91-day T-bill rate averaged 13.217 percent at last Monday's auction.
The central bank kept its benchmark overnight and term reverse repo rates unchanged.
The overnight borrowing rate remained at 25.0 percent, while the overnight lending rate at 27.0 percent.
On Sunday, central bank governor Gabriel Singson said he foresee further reduction in the overnight rates if the currency market continued to stabilise.
The four-day, two-week and one-month reverse repo rates were steady at 18 percent.
The two-month reverse repo rate was likewise unchanged at 13.0 percent, three-month rate at 13.25 percent and the six-month rate at 14.0 percent.
